device.description: 12-bit 200 kSPS 4-channel SAR ADC with start-bit serial interface
device.note: ads7841.pdf (SBAS084B) p.2 pin configurations and descriptions, p.3-4 specifications (VCC 4.75-5.25 V / 2.7-3.6 V, VIH to 5.5 V, straight binary), p.9 Tables I-II channel selection, p.10 digital interface (Figure 3, inputs 5.5 V tolerant), p.11 Tables III-V control byte, Figure 4, p.12 Tables VI-VII timing, Figures 5-6, p.13 data format; ads7841-q1.pdf (SBAS469C) terminal functions and recommended operating conditions for the -Q1 part

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the last control byte (S A2 A1 A0 MODE SGL/DIF PD1 PD0); no read-back, reset value not documented

commands.name: Control Byte
commands.note: Figure 3: PD0 latched on the 8th DCLK rising edge; DOUT low for one clock (BUSY high), then D11..D0 MSB first, then zeros. Tables I-II: A2-A0 = 001/101/010/110 give +IN = CH0/CH1/CH2/CH3 in both SGL/DIF modes

commands.name: Idle (no start bit)
commands.note: DIN is ignored until the start bit (the first HIGH bit after CS falls)

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3-4 (specs), p.9 (Tables I-II), p.10 (digital interface, Figure 3), p.11 (Tables III-V, Figure 4), p.12 (Tables VI-VII, Figures 5-6), p.13 (data format)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer and SGL/DIF selection (stored only); A2-A0 codes 000/011/100/111 are not listed in Tables I-II
8-bit conversion mode (MODE pin HIGH and MODE bit 1): the model always outputs 12 bits; for the 0 V code the 8-bit frame (0, D7..D0, zeros) is the same all-zero bit stream
conversion is clocked by DCLK (12 clocks after the control byte); not timed, the result is ready at once

BUSY: on the part it is a one-DCLK HIGH pulse (8th falling edge to 9th falling edge) after the control byte, and Hi-Z while CS is high; with the clocked conversion (time 0) the model only drives it LOW
DOUT and BUSY are Hi-Z while CS is high (the bus model floats DOUT; BUSY is driven)
power-down selection PD1-PD0 (auto power-down between conversions has no bus effect)
15-clock overlapped conversions where the next start bit arrives while the previous result is still shifting (Figure 6): the model restarts the reply at the new control byte
timing values are the 2.7-3.6 V table (Table VI); at 4.75-5.25 V they are 70-100 ns (Table VII)
variants: ADS7841-Q1 (ads7841-q1.pdf, ADS7841ESQDBQRQ1): same pinout (supply pins named VCC) and protocol. The DIP package in the datasheet has no orderable part.
